problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate a series of crates to identical cargo pallets for shipment. The crates are as follows:

* Crate Alpha: mass 37kg  
* Crate Beta: mass 70kg  
* Crate Gamma: mass 49kg  
* Crate Delta: mass 64kg  
* Crate Epsilon: mass 68kg  
* Crate Zeta: mass 39kg  
* Crate Eta: mass 57kg  
* Crate Theta: mass 60kg  
* Crate Iota: mass 35kg  
* Crate Kappa: mass 61kg  
* Crate Lambda: mass 44kg  
* Crate Mu: mass 64kg  
* Crate Nu: mass 55kg  
* Crate Xi: mass 47kg  
* Crate Omicron: mass 70kg  
* Crate Pi: mass 31kg  

Each pallet can safely support a maximum load of 100 kilograms. The coordinator must assign every crate to precisely one pallet, ensuring the combined mass on any pallet does not surpass its load limit. The objective is to complete this allocation while employing the smallest possible number of pallets.
